title: docs(adr): regenerate the ADR index for ADR-0160's amended status line
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DG44bgtJm8kWx4oK68re6GX)_

Fixes #37733

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感;查阅决策记录目录的人会看到「就记录问 AI」那条记录的状态说明换成了最新写法,写明它修订过不止一次(目录每格有长度上限,后半句照旧截断)。
- 为什么做:这条记录本周又修订了一次,目录由记录自动生成,却没有跟着重新生成;替查阅决策记录的人和读取目录的工具消除目录与记录的不一致。
- 出错会怎样:最多是目录里这一行文字不对,任何功能都不受影响;撤回这一次改动即恢复原样。
- 要你做什么:合入或批准这一次改动(决策记录目录属于须经你手的范围)。

## What changes

`docs/adr/README.md`, the generated ADR index, is regenerated with `node scripts/adr-index.mjs`. One row moves: the status cell of ADR-0160.

| | ADR-0160 status cell |
|:---|:---|
| before | `Accepted — merged 2026-11-24 (PR objectstack#37115); amended 2026-11-25 (s…` |
| after | `Accepted — merged 2026-11-24 (PR objectstack#37115); amended 2026-11-25, 2…` |

- Cause: the `**Status**:` line of ADR-0160 was rewritten twice without an index regeneration: by commit eec10407ac (PR #37573, `amended 2026-11-25 and 2026-11-26`) and then by commit 031a19dcfd (PR #37785, which added the fifth and sixth amendments, `amended 2026-11-25, 2026-11-26 and 2026-11-27`). Both touched the record only. The index projects that line clipped to the cell width, so the visible change is the clipped tail.
- Diff: 1 file, +1 / −1 (line 230). No ADR body, no script, no other index row.
- The file is generator output. Nothing in it is hand-edited or hand-trimmed.
- No changeset: `docs/adr/**` ships in no released package, so this pull request carries `skip-changeset`, declared on the create.

## Tests

No package is touched, so there is no build closure to make and no package test or typecheck to run. The generator's own self-test ran inside `pnpm check:adr-index`: 60 assertions, green.

## Acceptance notes

- Card acceptance, "`adr:index` regenerated on main; its check passes with no other index change": `node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check` exits 1 (stale) on `main` and exits 0 on this branch at its head 49760721ca (the area's re-run after #37785 landed), and the net diff against `main` is the ADR-0160 row alone. "No other index change" is a measured reading here, not an assumption.
- Idempotent: a second `node scripts/adr-index.mjs` on the regenerated tree prints `unchanged` and leaves the same blob (ef06360678 at 49760721ca; 803949a6b7 was the first head's).
- The row does not show the new date itself. The generator clips the status cell at a fixed width and the clip lands inside `, 2026-11-26 and 2026-11-27`.
- `main` moved while this was in flight. The branch carries one merge commit, 031596331e (`main` at c826e8a156, which brought in #37785), and the index was regenerated on top of it in 49760721ca. `main` has since moved four more commits to 9b50fedbfa (#37798, #37783, #37821, #37826); none of them touches `docs/adr/`, `ui/docs/adr/` or the generator, so the index stays current against today's `main`.
- Governed surface: `docs/adr/**` is Tier H. This pull request is opened as a draft and is left as one; landing it is the maintainer's act.
- Noted, not filed: the index went stale with nothing red because its check is report-only by ruling. The last index regeneration on `main`, commit 972114df4d, did not carry the new ADR-0160 status text, so that index was generated on a tree without eec10407ac and the file then text-merged. That is the expected cost of a report-only check, not a defect.

## Verification

Read first, one file:

1. `docs/adr/README.md`, line 230, the only hunk of the net diff. The risk to check is that the row is exactly what the generator prints for the current `**Status**:` line of ADR-0160, and that nothing else moved.

Two-minute check: on this branch run `node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check`. Expected: the line `adr-index: OK — docs/adr/README.md is current and every record parsed.` and exit 0. On `main` the same command prints `docs/adr/README.md is stale` and exits 1.

<details>

`pnpm check:adr-index` printed: `adr-index --report: OK — docs/adr/README.md is current, every record parsed, self-test 60 assertions green.`

The `check:doc-formula-expressions` line is its second run. The first exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` were not built in this worktree. Both were then built under the shared verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`) and the gate was run again. Every other family is left to CI on this pull request.
